title: A man of 100 faces
objectives: apply Present Simple 3rd person singular -s rules

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for A man of 100 faces.
Welcome to today's lesson: A man of 100 faces! Today we will practice how to apply Present Simple 3rd person singular -s rules.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for A man of 100 faces:
apply Present Simple 3rd person singular -s rules; describe professional daily schedules

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: eat, drink, work, doctor, teacher, programmer

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Choose the correct form: 'He ___ breakfast at six.'

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: My friend is a programmer. He works at home, drinks coffee, and eats lunch at one o'clock.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
He works as a doctor. He eats breakfast at six and drinks tea. He works hard every day.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Describe the daily routine of a family member or professional using 3rd person -s forms.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: apply Present Simple 3rd person singular -s rules, describe professional daily schedules.
